title: Phase 1 consolidation & gate
objective: No new topics. Pass the Step 1 exit test, run the DSA D1 timed set, write PairCraft’s first technical design doc, and take the Phase 1 assessment.
theory: Consolidation: what you can do cold is what you know.
deliverables: PairCraft design doc v1 (Google-style: context, goals, non-goals, design, alternatives, risks)

knowledge: Which of the 7 P1 knowledge questions did you miss?
Which D1 pattern is still slowest to recognize?
practical: Phase 1 gate pass criteria all met

tasks.text: Exit test: from a raw CSV, clean + groupby + plot in 30 min; then the cohort query in pandas and SQL, cold. Then explain a CI aloud. Log results.
Re-solve cold: the 6 D1 problems you marked hardest in mistakes.md. Note pattern names within 2–3 minutes of reading each.
Timed set: 2 unseen LeetCode mediums (arrays/strings/binary search) in 45 minutes, narrating aloud. Log pass/fail + gap type.
Review every D1 solution in your repo: add a one-line pattern name + complexity to each file. Group by gap type in mistakes.md.
Revise closures, decorators, generators, exceptions, dataclasses: reimplement @retry, a file-streaming generator and a dataclass with validation without notes.
Revise NumPy broadcasting, cosine similarity, pandas groupby/merge, window functions: 10 mixed drills, no lookups.

Write PairCraft design doc v1 (Google style): context, goals/non-goals, requirements, high-level design, detailed design (sync protocol, queue), alternatives considered (CRDT vs OT vs LWW; WebSocket vs WebRTC data channel), risks, metrics, rollout.
10-min recall: explain yesterday’s “Write PairCraft design doc v1 (Google style): context, goals/non-goals, requirements, high” aloud without notes; write one gap you found.
Take the Phase 1 gate (Assessments → P1): knowledge questions aloud, coding checks timed, practical checks from a clean clone. Record the result.
If passed: tick m-python, m-data, m-dsa1; write the weekly review. If not: follow the “fail → revisit” items for the failed part before opening W10.
Attend/replay 100xSchool sessions; LinkedIn build-note: “8 weeks in — what the diagnostic looks like now vs W1”.

MERN revision · Express: middleware order, error-handling middleware, async errors, validation (zod), pagination/versioning/idempotency, rate limiting, helmet/CORS, security best practices. Audit PairCraft’s API against a 12-point checklist you write from the docs; fix 3 items.

Weekly revision — Step 1 exit test, DSA D1 timed set + re-solves, Python/data revision, PairCraft technical design doc: rewrite the key ideas from memory (no notes), then compare with your notes and fix the gaps. Reimplement two things from this week without looking.
DSA spaced re-solve (from W6): Valid Parentheses (Easy, B75) · Min Stack (Medium) — cold, ≤30 min each, narrate.
Weekly review: answer this week’s knowledge questions aloud, run the practical checks, then write the three notes (struggled / learned / improve) in Weekly Plan → Review. Update the tracking sheet.

JS drill · array methods & immutability: implement groupBy, chunk, uniqueBy, flatten(depth) with reduce; explain the sort-without-comparator trap. (Side Tracks → 🟨 JavaScript & MERN Refresher has the full module.)
Plan next week: read W10’s objective and Day 1; move any unfinished 🔴 task into next week’s Day 1; confirm calendar blocks. Then rest — consistency beats intensity.
